segments.text: Let's get started. The first item on the agenda is the new bus schedule.
I read the draft last night and I have a few concerns about the early routes.
Same here. The six o'clock bus is always full.
We looked at adding a second bus, but the budget is tight this year.
About ten percent less than last year.
Then maybe we move the later route earlier instead of adding one.
Okay. Let's ask the drivers what they think before we decide anything.
I can call them tomorrow morning.
And I will send everyone the numbers from last spring.
Good. Then we meet again next week.
